name: Lady Light
description: A former rescue pilot who bends light into shields, signals, and solid paths through danger.
biography:
Mara Venn flew night rescues through the towers of Meridian. When the city's transit ring failed during a blackout, she used an experimental beacon to guide a rescue crew across a broken span. The beacon burned out in her hands, but the bridge of light held until the last passenger made it across.

She still wears the amber lamp from her flight suit. After dark, crews look for that narrow glow above a damaged building or at the far end of a street the power grid has lost. People started calling her Lady Light after she spent an entire night holding a roof up while neighbors dug each other out.
